## Plan and billing FAQs

How much does Levitate cost?

Levitate is one plan with every feature included, built and priced for small businesses. Website Prestige, ads and handwritten cards (priced per card) are optional add-ons, and new customers may get first-year pricing. [Book a demo](https://www.levitate.ai/contact) and we'll give you an exact quote on the call.

Are there any contracts?

Levitate subscriptions have a one-year commitment. Levitate is an annual subscription service, and you can choose not to renew at your next annual renewal date at any time. You will then have access to the platform for the remainder of the 12 month billing cycle that you originally purchased but not have your account renewed for the following year.

How will I get billed?

Levitate plans are billed annually based on when you signed up for the service. If you joined on August 1st, you will be billed again on August 1st of the following year.

What does the pricing look like for a business with more than 5 users?

We offer pricing plans that can be customized for your business. [Schedule a demo](https://www.levitate.ai/contact) with one of our team members and we’ll come up with a plan suited to your needs.

Do I need a website to use Levitate?

No. Levitate works on its own. Websites are optional, but awesome.

[See all FAQs](https://www.levitate.ai/faqs#faq-general-questions)
